original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.
Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.

actual_scope: Close exact support size seven for the selected PR1094 calls-0/4 whole-later-query information-repair model by exhaustive classification of reduced length-six route relations; derive the resulting exact repair minimum for all owner blocks of size at most seven.
scope_change_reason: The predecessor centre-block audit established that blocks of up to six owners cannot compress repair information and proved only a support lower bound of seven. The explicit donor target κ>0.1 motivates testing this first uncovered support size: a positive common-kernel instance could change the center-sharing information budget. The new finite route census closes only size seven and does not authorize a larger synthesis campaign.
bottleneck_link: A target-scale gain requires a changed paid profile or coverage law. This tests whether blockwise center repair can reduce the information budget on even the smallest newly eligible owner block; observation dimension remains distinct from recursive rank and cost.
stop_rule: Stop at support size seven. Do not search size eight or begin physical synthesis until a complete replacement endpoint passes the exact κ=0.1 optimistic moment with positive headroom for physical costs; after that gate, test only one named size-eight block.
evidence: Exact source-bound enumeration of 1,379,952 reduced route triple-products finds 50 cyclic length-six relations; all are braid relations and their route-label graph is triangle-free. The support-seven incidence count forces a Fano plane, which would require a triangle in that graph. Thus support is at least eight and repair stays exactly 104|B| for every block of at most seven owners.
